findings.evidence: Web search: 'UN Regulation No 162 provides uniform technical prescriptions concerning approval of immobilizers and approval of a vehicle with regard to its immobilizer.' No cybersecurity scope stated; category scope not confirmed.

findings.proposed: Say R83 sets pollutant emission requirements by series (Euro 5/6-equivalent levels); 'Euro 5/6' is EU terminology, and 'Fuel safety'/'Fuel tanks' tags are weak
findings.evidence: Record title 'Emissions from M1 and N1 Category Vehicles (Euro 5/6)'; no body text supports 'Euro' labelling (stub body). Unverified against UN R83 text.

findings.current: systems: Emissions; commodities incl. Fuel system

findings.evidence: Repo title: 'Measurement of Net Power and Maximum 30-Minutes Power'; summary mentions only power measurement.
